# Independent review: four documentation SHA source decisions

Supports the bounded main-line four-row proposal `161d27d64fb42063eeaab8e57a8d30f5d4c41e57cad72940bc9eb9fe819994d0`, manifest `606d18fb123feed49ac6a7f6a84b95c5e9e5915db72f1aa3fb2449b8e0712599`, against base fdcdadee28c4552e3500b5099de9f42e456adb5c. All four complete parent diff bytes independently match the cached angular/components Git objects. The retained primary responses report verified signatures; this review independently checked Git object/diff identity, not the signing service or a new network response.

* `bae95399` changes only the wording of Material input's error-message paragraph. The current peer default matcher implements invalid AND (touched OR submitted); the owned local matcher delegation also permits a caller-provided matcher, so this is not a universal rule for custom matchers. Current input and error-state source/spec context has been reviewed; no implementation change is in the upstream diff.
* `22bd09a0` inserts a missing word in CDK virtual-viewport window-scrolling prose. The owned legacy viewport service and exported scope do not turn this prose edit into an implementation change.
* `01ec1e0e` inserts a blank line before the current Material button variants table. Legacy selector and module sources are the relevant owned context; the hunk adds no button behavior.
* `e482240f` removes a duplicated word from autocomplete requireSelection documentation. The owned option-selection API and spec provide relevant context; the wording edit itself adds no API or behavior.

For each reviewed main and 21.x Git checkpoint I independently verified every recorded owned-source hash and the absence of the exact upstream Markdown path. The ng-packagr asset configuration and retained component README context support the narrow exact-path finding, not a claim that published packages contain no Markdown. Recorded main proof members also match physical canonical HEAD 8e9e7316806fe9266373865b0784e9917659e5e8 at review time.

The patch strictly applies in a private index and yields tree `54ad8f4ddb311b05cc070f40ff7f8c019d6d6911`. All 1,697 ledger rows retain order; only the four target rows change, and an independent TypeScript JSON-AST comparison confirms the other 1,693 raw row spans remain identical. The four complete previous ledger rows match the base and their embedded retained_prior_row copies. Their current 8e9 ledger preimages also match the base; integration must recheck the moving tree.

An independent run of the unchanged production dispatcher against an isolated proposal fixture accepted all four rows with no target evidence or review failures. It reported structural result pass and exit 0 in non-admission mode, while overall disposition admission remains incomplete: 116 missing evidence, 777 insufficient individual and 485 missing branch applicability. Independently rerun wrong-commit report-identity, wrong-diff proof-digest, and wrong-branch controls reopened all four individual reviews; the branch control also reopened all four branch-scope checks. Non-admission exit 0 on the controls does not mean admission passed. These controls bind evidence identity and structure, not the truth of the human source judgment.

No component tests, product build, packed/browser runtime, security clearance, full G11, or entire docs-category closure is claimed.
